notes.title: Massive Update For Cube Foundry!
notes.content: [p]This update brings a wave of fresh changes to "Cube Foundry," with a strong focus on strategic depth, visual enhancements, and a completely revamped user experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Gameplay Mechanics 🎮[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Combo System:[/b] We've introduced a new mechanic to reward active play! Now, consecutive clicks on the cube build up a combo counter, applying a growing multiplier to your cubes-per-click. The faster you click, the greater the rewards![/p][/*][*][p][b]Synergy System:[/b] Generators now work better together! Purchasing generators of the same type will unlock passive synergy bonuses, permanently boosting their output. This adds a new layer of strategy to choosing which generators to buy and upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revamped Mastery System:[/b] The Mastery System has been overhauled to be more impactful. The bonuses it provides have been significantly buffed, making specialization in a single generator an even more viable and effective long-term strategy.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI & UX Improvements ✨[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Complete Cube Visual Rework:[/b] The heart of the game, our beloved cube, has received a full visual upgrade! It's now rendered with a more advanced technique, giving it a true 3D look with lighting and shadow effects that enhance its depth and rotation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Total UI Overhaul:[/b] The game's interface has been redesigned from the ground up to be cleaner, more modern, and more intuitive.[/p][list][*][p][b]Side Panels:[/b] The Generator and Upgrade panels have been restyled for a more appealing look and better readability, making it easier to manage your cube empire.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Top Bar:[/b] The top info bar has been reorganized to display crucial data more clearly and less intrusively.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Reworked Prestige Panel:[/b] The Prestige panel not only has a new look but also offers new, more compelling upgrades to unlock, giving you more strategic goals to pursue after each reset.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Generator Limit Removed:[/b] We've removed the display cap on the number of generators in the panel. You can now scroll through the entire list without restriction, allowing you to plan your expansion without limits.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balancing & Changes ⚖️[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Generator Cost Rebalance:[/b] We have recalibrated the base costs of generators and how they increase after an "Astral Boost." Progression will now require more careful planning, encouraging diversification rather than focusing solely on the most expensive generators.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Accessibility & Performance ⚙️[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Settings Panel:[/b] A new settings panel has been introduced! From here, you can adjust the game's graphics quality. If you notice performance drops, especially after the latest visual upgrades, you can lower the quality for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Cube Foundry - The "Evolution" Patch Notes
notes.content: [h3]New Gameplay Mechanics 🚀[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Prestige System:[/b] A new layer of strategy has been unlocked for the late game![/p][list][*][p][/p][p][b]How it Works:[/b] Once you reach a certain production threshold, you can choose to "Prestige." This will reset your current run's progress (cubes, generators, and standard upgrades).[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Reward:[/b] In exchange, you will earn permanent [b]Prestige Points (PP)[/b]. These points can be spent in a brand-new skill tree to unlock powerful, permanent upgrades that affect all future runs, accelerating your progress and allowing you to reach new heights.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Overclock System (Toggle):[/b] A new risk/reward mechanic has been introduced![/p][list][*][p][b]Activation:[/b] A new central "OC" button allows you to toggle Overclock mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Function:[/b] While active, your global CPS (Cubes Per Second) increases dramatically, but a "System Stress" bar also fills up. The higher the Stress, the greater the risk of a "Meltdown" with negative consequences.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Strategy:[/b] The player must decide how long to keep Overclock active to maximize gains without causing a catastrophic failure.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Generator-to-Click Synergy:[/b] A new progression mechanic has been created for the mid-game.[/p][list][*][p][b]Unlock:[/b] Reaching 15 units of a specific generator type unlocks a unique "Synergy" upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Effect:[/b] Once purchased, this upgrade permanently adds a percentage of that generator type's total CPS to your CPC (Cubes Per Click).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]User Interface & Experience Improvements ✨[/p][list][*][p][b]New Control Layout:[/b] The bottom command bar has been completely redesigned for a cleaner, more modern look.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main Background:[/b] The backdrop behind the central cube has been enhanced with a parallax effect, dimmed star brightness, and a slight blur to create a sense of depth and focus the action.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b][i]Game Balancing[/i][/b] ⚖️[/p][list][*][p][b]Mid-Game Pacing:[/b] To make the progression curve steeper, new logic has been implemented for Prestige and Astral Boosts.[/p][list][*][p][b]Increasing Prestige Cost:[/b] After earning the first Prestige Point in a run, the cube cost for each subsequent point doubles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Post-Astral Generator Cost:[/b] After performing an Astral Boost on a generator, its costIncreaseFactor now increases, making it more expensive to continue buying and encouraging diversification.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Generator Expansion:[/b] The generator list has been rebalanced with more thematic names, and new end-game generators have been added. The display limit has been increased from 4 to 6.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Community Fixes & Small Improvements
notes.content:

Added a tooltip when hovering over CPS — it’s now easier to understand what’s going on at a glance!

⚖️ Balancing
Slight rebalance of the early game to make progression smoother and less grindy in the beginning.

✨ New Mechanics
Introduced a mini astral upgrade mechanic — a little bonus for hitting certain generator milestones!

🏆 For the Achievement Hunters
Added 2 new achievements — good luck finding them!

notes.title: Major Update – Mastery, Prestige, and Strategic Overhaul!
notes.content:
[b]🚀 CUBE FOUNDRY – MAJOR UPDATE![/b]

The Foundry just got a full-scale overhaul. This update introduces new [b]meta-progression mechanics, smarter upgrade paths, and a deepened production strategy[/b] that expands your cube empire like never before.

---

[h3]⚙️ What’s New:[/h3]

[b]🖱️ Reworked CPC & CPS Core Loop[/b]
- Clicking is now more meaningful with synergies between active and passive income
- Boost your production through smart balance and upgrades

[b]🏗️ Generator Rebalancing[/b]
- All generators now cap at 100 units each
- Recalibrated costs and multipliers ensure exponential scaling feels great

[b]🧩 Upgrade Branches Introduced[/b]
- Upgrades are now structured into thematic paths: Click, Generators, Economy, and more
- Prerequisites and specialization bring new depth to your progression

[b]🔁 Prestige System (New Game+)[/b]
- Reset your progress to earn [b]Prestige Points (PP)[/b]
- Unlock permanent upgrades: global multipliers, early-game boosts, and exclusive modifiers

[b]🧠 Mastery System (Endgame Meta)[/b]
- Produce cubes to earn Mastery XP and level up
- Gain [b]Mastery Points[/b] and invest in 5 attributes: Power (CPC), Efficiency (CPS), Economy, Prestige, and Luck
- Permanent, passive bonuses that grow with each run

[b]🏆 Achievements (Now with Secrets!)[/b]
- New rewards for click count, cubes generated, generator milestones, prestige resets, and more
- Secret achievements are now live — can you find them all?

---

[h3]🛠️ Technical Improvements[/h3]

- Integrated [b]native anti-cheat module[/b] to prevent auto-clicking and time manipulation
- [b]Auto-save every 30 seconds[/b] to protect your progress
- [b]Full localization support[/b] (English & Italian, more coming)

---

[h3]🎯 Thanks for Playing![/h3]
